en: The account of Coptotermes bannaensis in the Chinese termite volume records the species from Jinghong, Yunnan, but provides no morphological description of the soldier, the alate or the worker. The species can therefore be recognized only through characters of the genus, in which the frontal gland opens on a short tube at the front of the head and the soldier mandibles are sabre-shaped, the left one carrying a basal notch and a few small crenulations along the inner edge.
